blurb: Guests skydive at Jean Sport Aviation Center in Jean, NV. All participants must be 18 or older with valid ID. Weight limits apply with extra charges for weights over 220 lbs.
extraNote: Deposit required to book, fully refundable up to 48 hours before skydive check-in time · Deposit non-refundable if no show or booking made less than 48 hours before experience · Name changes permitted on deposits at any time · Reservations can be changed up to 5pm the day before booked date, subject to availability and price difference · Weather dependent; delays or reschedules possible with deposit transferred to new date · Jean Sport Aviation Center, 23600 S Las Vegas Blvd, Jean, NV 89019, United States
